title: TOEIC Listening & Reading Full Test 01
description: Đề thi đầy đủ theo cấu trúc đề TOEIC Listening & Reading của IIG Việt Nam: 200 câu, 120 phút. Listening – Part 1 đến Part 4 (câu 1–100), audio chạy liên tục khoảng 45 phút, mỗi đoạn chỉ nghe một lần. Reading – Part 5 đến Part 7 (câu 101–200), 75 phút. Có hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý, câu hỏi biểu đồ, chèn câu, đoạn kép và ba đoạn; mỗi câu đều có giải thích tiếng Việt.

groups.transcript:
(A) A man is repairing his bicycle.
(B) A man is riding along a path.
(C) Some trees are being planted.
(D) A man is sitting on a bench.

options.A: A man is repairing his bicycle.
options.B: A man is riding along a path.
options.D: A man is sitting on a bench.

questions.explanation: Người đàn ông đang đạp xe trên lối đi trong công viên → (B). (A) anh ta không sửa xe; (C) 'are being planted' cần có người đang trồng cây; (D) ghế băng đang trống – bẫy nhắc tới vật có trong ảnh nhưng sai hành động.

groups.transcript:
(A) A worker is climbing a ladder.
(B) Some bricks are being loaded onto a truck.
(C) A crane is being taken apart.
(D) A man has a safety helmet on.

options.A: A worker is climbing a ladder.
options.B: Some bricks are being loaded onto a truck.
options.C: A crane is being taken apart.
options.D: A man has a safety helmet on.

questions.explanation: Người công nhân đang đội mũ bảo hộ → 'has a safety helmet on' (D). Ảnh không có thang (A), không có xe tải (B); cần cẩu đứng yên, không ai đang tháo dỡ (C – 'take apart' = tháo rời).

groups.transcript:
(A) A train is stopped at a platform.
(B) Some passengers are boarding a bus.
(C) A woman is carrying a suitcase up some stairs.
(D) A clock is being repaired.

options.A: A train is stopped at a platform.
options.B: Some passengers are boarding a bus.
options.C: A woman is carrying a suitcase up some stairs.

questions.explanation: Đoàn tàu đang dừng cạnh sân ga số 2 → (A). (B) là xe buýt, không phải tàu; (C) chiếc vali đặt trên sân ga, không có cầu thang; (D) đồng hồ treo tường không có ai đang sửa.

groups.transcript:
(A) A woman is unpacking a suitcase.
(B) Some keys are being handed to a guest.
(C) A suitcase has been placed next to a counter.
(D) A plant is being watered.

options.A: A woman is unpacking a suitcase.
options.B: Some keys are being handed to a guest.
options.C: A suitcase has been placed next to a counter.

questions.explanation: Chiếc vali đã được đặt cạnh quầy lễ tân – 'has been placed' mô tả trạng thái → (C). (A) cô lễ tân không mở vali; (B) chìa khoá vẫn treo trên bảng, không có khách nhận; (D) không ai đang tưới cây.

groups.transcript:
(A) A boat is being lifted out of the water.
(B) Some people are swimming near a pier.
(C) Some fishermen are repairing their nets.
(D) Some boats are floating on the water.

options.A: A boat is being lifted out of the water.
options.B: Some people are swimming near a pier.
options.C: Some fishermen are repairing their nets.
options.D: Some boats are floating on the water.

questions.explanation: Ảnh không có người; vài chiếc thuyền đang nổi trên mặt nước gần cầu tàu → (D). (A) 'is being lifted' cần có hành động nâng thuyền; (B), (C) nhắc tới người không có trong ảnh.

groups.transcript:
(A) Some bicycles have been parked in a row.
(B) A cyclist is locking a bike to a rack.
(C) A road is being repaved.
(D) Some cars are waiting at a traffic light.

options.A: Some bicycles have been parked in a row.
options.B: A cyclist is locking a bike to a rack.
options.D: Some cars are waiting at a traffic light.

questions.explanation: Năm chiếc xe đạp đã được dựng thành một hàng trên vỉa hè → (A) (bị động hoàn thành mô tả trạng thái). (B) không có người; (C) không ai đang trải nhựa đường; (D) chỉ có một chiếc taxi và không có đèn giao thông.

groups.transcript:
Where's the closest post office?
(A) By express delivery.
(B) About twelve dollars.
(C) It's two blocks down, on Elm Street.

options.C: It's two blocks down, on Elm Street.

questions.explanation: Where → hỏi địa điểm: 'cách đây hai dãy nhà, trên phố Elm' (C). (A) trả lời How (gửi bằng cách nào), (B) trả lời How much – đều liên tưởng tới bưu điện nhưng sai dạng câu hỏi.

groups.transcript:
When does the new cafeteria open?
(A) Next Monday, I think.
(B) It's on the ground floor.
(C) A wide variety of salads.

questions.explanation: When → thời điểm: 'thứ Hai tới' (A). (B) trả lời Where; (C) nói về món ăn – liên tưởng tới 'cafeteria'.

groups.transcript:
Who's in charge of the product launch?
(A) At the convention center.
(B) Ms. Tanaka from Marketing.
(C) It was launched last spring.

questions.explanation: Who's in charge → người phụ trách: 'Cô Tanaka bên Marketing' (B). (A) trả lời Where; (C) lặp từ 'launch' và sai thì (sự kiện chưa diễn ra).

groups.transcript:
Why is the parking garage closed today?
(A) The lines are being repainted.
(B) Close to the main entrance.
(C) I parked on the second level.

options.C: I parked on the second level.

questions.explanation: Why → lý do: bãi xe đóng cửa vì 'đang sơn lại vạch kẻ' (A). (B) bẫy đồng âm 'closed – close'; (C) lặp từ 'park' nhưng không nêu lý do.

groups.transcript:
How often do you back up your computer files?
(A) At the back of the room.
(B) Every Friday afternoon.
(C) Yes, I made a copy.

options.A: At the back of the room.

questions.explanation: How often → tần suất: 'chiều thứ Sáu hằng tuần' (B). (A) bẫy lặp từ 'back'; (C) câu hỏi Wh- không trả lời bằng Yes/No.

groups.transcript:
Would you like to join us for lunch at the new Thai place?
(A) He joined the company in May.
(B) The menu is on the table.
(C) Sure, what time are you leaving?

options.A: He joined the company in May.
options.B: The menu is on the table.
options.C: Sure, what time are you leaving?

questions.explanation: Lời mời 'Would you like to…?' → nhận lời và hỏi thêm giờ đi (C). (A) lặp 'join' và sai chủ ngữ 'He'; (B) liên tưởng 'lunch – menu'.

groups.transcript:
Should I print the agenda, or just e-mail it to everyone?
(A) E-mail is fine.
(B) Yes, I've already read it.
(C) At the next staff meeting.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn (A or B) → chọn một phương án: 'gửi e-mail là được' (A). Câu hỏi lựa chọn thường không trả lời bằng Yes (B); (C) trả lời When.

groups.transcript:
Isn't Mr. Kim supposed to be here by now?
(A) Here's the guest list.
(B) I suppose it's a bit warmer.
(C) His flight was delayed an hour.

options.B: I suppose it's a bit warmer.
options.C: His flight was delayed an hour.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi phủ định thắc mắc sao ông Kim chưa tới → giải thích gián tiếp: 'chuyến bay của ông ấy bị trễ một tiếng' (C). (A) lặp âm 'here'; (B) lặp âm 'suppose'.

groups.transcript:
The quarterly report still needs a few charts.
(A) Four times a year.
(B) I'll add them this afternoon.
(C) Yes, it was reported last quarter.

options.C: Yes, it was reported last quarter.

questions.explanation: Câu trần thuật nêu việc còn thiếu (vài biểu đồ) → đáp lại bằng hành động: 'chiều nay tôi sẽ thêm vào' (B). (A) liên tưởng 'quarterly' = hằng quý; (C) lặp 'report', 'quarter'.

groups.transcript:
What time does the safety workshop start?
(A) In the main training hall.
(B) It's been postponed until next week.
(C) A workshop on fire prevention.

options.B: It's been postponed until next week.

questions.explanation: Hỏi giờ bắt đầu → câu trả lời gián tiếp: buổi hội thảo 'đã bị hoãn sang tuần sau' (B) – dạng đáp án rất hay gặp. (A) trả lời Where; (C) lặp 'workshop'.

groups.transcript:
Which moving company did you end up hiring?
(A) We haven't made a decision yet.
(B) I'm moving next month.
(C) Around five hundred dollars.

options.A: We haven't made a decision yet.

questions.explanation: Which company → 'chúng tôi vẫn chưa quyết định' (A) – kiểu trả lời 'chưa biết/chưa quyết' luôn đúng với mọi câu hỏi Wh-. (B) lặp 'moving'; (C) trả lời How much.

groups.transcript:
How did the client presentation go?
(A) By taxi, I think.
(B) Next Thursday at ten.
(C) Better than we expected.

questions.explanation: 'How did … go?' hỏi kết quả/diễn biến → 'tốt hơn chúng tôi mong đợi' (C). (A) hiểu nhầm 'go' là đi lại bằng phương tiện; (B) trả lời When.

groups.transcript:
You've used this design software before, haven't you?
(A) A software engineer.
(B) Only for a couple of weeks.
(C) It's working again now.

options.B: Only for a couple of weeks.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi đuôi xác nhận đã từng dùng phần mềm → 'chỉ vài tuần thôi' (ngầm hiểu: có, nhưng ít) (B). (A) lặp 'software'; (C) liên tưởng tới phần mềm bị lỗi.

groups.transcript:
Could you help me carry these boxes to the storage room?
(A) Sure, just give me a minute.
(B) The movie starts at eight.
(C) They're larger boxes.

options.A: Sure, just give me a minute.

questions.explanation: Lời nhờ vả 'Could you help me…?' → đồng ý: 'Được, đợi tôi một phút' (A). (B) bẫy âm gần 'move – movie'; (C) lặp 'boxes'.

groups.transcript:
Why don't we hold the training session online this year?
(A) Because the trainer was ill.
(B) It's on the second floor.
(C) That would definitely save on travel costs.

options.C: That would definitely save on travel costs.

questions.explanation: 'Why don't we…?' là lời ĐỀ NGHỊ, không hỏi lý do → đáp lại bằng đồng tình: 'như vậy chắc chắn tiết kiệm chi phí đi lại' (C). (A) bẫy 'Why – Because'; (B) trả lời Where.

groups.transcript:
Where can I find the updated price list?
(A) The prices went up in March.
(B) It's been posted on the company intranet.
(C) Yes, I found it very useful.

options.A: The prices went up in March.
options.B: It's been posted on the company intranet.
options.C: Yes, I found it very useful.

questions.explanation: Where → 'đã được đăng trên mạng nội bộ công ty' (B). (A) lặp 'price'; (C) lặp 'find – found' và dùng Yes cho câu hỏi Wh-.

groups.transcript:
Has the maintenance team fixed the air conditioner yet?
(A) A technician is working on it right now.
(B) The air is very dry today.
(C) It's a fixed monthly rate.

options.A: A technician is working on it right now.
options.B: The air is very dry today.

questions.explanation: Hỏi đã sửa xong chưa → 'kỹ thuật viên đang sửa ngay bây giờ' (= chưa xong) (A). (B) lặp 'air'; (C) lặp 'fixed' với nghĩa khác (cố định).

groups.transcript:
When will the new interns start?
(A) At the reception desk.
(B) Yes, they already did.
(C) Not until the beginning of July.

options.C: Not until the beginning of July.

questions.explanation: When → 'phải đến đầu tháng Bảy' (C). (A) trả lời Where; (B) dùng Yes cho câu hỏi Wh- và sai thì.

groups.transcript:
Do you want a window seat or an aisle seat?
(A) Please have a seat.
(B) Whichever is available.
(C) The windows were cleaned yesterday.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn → 'chỗ nào còn trống cũng được' (B) – cách trả lời không chọn cụ thể nhưng vẫn phù hợp. (A) lặp 'seat'; (C) lặp 'window'.

groups.transcript:
I can't find my security badge anywhere.
(A) Someone turned one in at the front desk.
(B) Security has been improved.
(C) The badges are printed in blue.

options.A: Someone turned one in at the front desk.
options.C: The badges are printed in blue.

questions.explanation: Than phiền không tìm thấy thẻ an ninh → gợi ý hữu ích: 'có người đã nộp một chiếc ở quầy lễ tân' (A). (B) lặp 'security'; (C) lặp 'badge'. 'turn in' = nộp lại.

groups.transcript:
Who approved the budget for the Madrid project?
(A) Not until next quarter.
(B) About twenty thousand euros.
(C) The finance director signed off on it.

options.C: The finance director signed off on it.

questions.explanation: Who approved → 'giám đốc tài chính đã ký duyệt' (C); 'sign off on' = phê duyệt. (A) trả lời When; (B) trả lời How much – liên tưởng 'budget'.

groups.transcript:
Let's review the survey results before the meeting.
(A) The review was very positive.
(B) Good idea. How about at two o'clock?
(C) About three hundred customers.

options.B: Good idea. How about at two o'clock?

questions.explanation: 'Let's…' là lời đề nghị → đồng ý và đề xuất thời gian (B). (A) lặp 'review' với nghĩa 'bài nhận xét'; (C) liên tưởng 'survey' (số người khảo sát).

groups.transcript:
Aren't the new brochures supposed to arrive today?
(A) The printer called to say they'll be late.
(B) Yes, I arrived this morning.
(C) They're very colorful.

options.A: The printer called to say they'll be late.

questions.explanation: Hỏi tờ rơi có đến hôm nay không → 'bên in đã gọi báo sẽ giao trễ' (A). (B) lặp 'arrive' sai chủ ngữ; (C) nói về tờ rơi nhưng không trả lời câu hỏi.

groups.transcript:
How much will it cost to repair the copier?
(A) Two copies, please.
(B) It's next to the window.
(C) The technician will send us an estimate.

options.C: The technician will send us an estimate.

questions.explanation: How much → trả lời gián tiếp: 'kỹ thuật viên sẽ gửi báo giá' (chưa biết chính xác) (C). (A) bẫy âm 'copier – copies'; (B) trả lời Where.

groups.transcript:
Would you mind closing the door on your way out?
(A) It closes at nine.
(B) Not at all.
(C) On the way to the airport.

options.C: On the way to the airport.

questions.explanation: 'Would you mind + V-ing?' → đồng ý giúp thì trả lời 'Not at all' (= không phiền gì) (B). (A) lặp 'close'; (C) lặp 'way'.

groups.transcript:
W: Hello, I'm calling from Brightway Consulting. I'd like to reserve your private dining room for a team dinner on Friday the twentieth. There'll be about eighteen of us.
M: Let me check. I'm sorry, the private room is already booked that evening. But we could set up a long table on our rooftop terrace. It seats up to twenty people.
W: The terrace sounds nice, but what if it rains?
M: Don't worry. The terrace has a retractable roof, so we can cover it if the weather changes.
W: Perfect. Could you also e-mail me your group menu? I'd like to share it with my colleagues so they can choose their meals in advance.
M: Of course. What's your e-mail address?

questions.content: What is the purpose of the woman's call?

options.B: To book a space for an event

questions.explanation: 'I'd like to reserve your private dining room for a team dinner' → đặt chỗ cho một buổi tiệc của nhóm. 'reserve' được diễn đạt lại thành 'book a space'.

questions.content: Why does the man suggest the rooftop terrace?
questions.explanation: 'The private room is already booked that evening. But we could set up… on our rooftop terrace' → gợi ý sân thượng vì phòng riêng đã có người đặt.

questions.content: What does the woman ask the man to send her?
questions.explanation: 'Could you also e-mail me your group menu?' → gửi thực đơn cho nhóm.

groups.transcript:
M: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Victor Ramos. It's for a compact car for three days.
W: Yes, Mr. Ramos, I see it here. Actually, we ran out of compact cars this morning because several flights arrived early. But I can give you a mid-size sedan at no extra cost.
M: That's great, thanks. Is there a charge if I return it at your downtown branch instead of here at the airport?
W: There's a twenty-five dollar drop-off fee for that. If you'd like, I can also add a GPS navigation unit for five dollars a day.
M: No, thanks. I'll just use my phone. Where do I pick up the car?
W: Take the shuttle bus right outside those doors to parking lot C.

questions.content: Where does the conversation most likely take place?
questions.explanation: Khách có đặt trước xe 'compact car', nhân viên nhắc 'here at the airport' → quầy cho thuê xe ở sân bay.

questions.content: What problem does the woman mention?

options.D: A type of vehicle is not available.

questions.explanation: 'We ran out of compact cars this morning' → loại xe khách đặt đã hết. (A) sai vì nhân viên đã tìm thấy đặt chỗ ('I see it here').

questions.content: What will the man most likely do next?
questions.explanation: Nhân viên hướng dẫn: 'Take the shuttle bus… to parking lot C' để nhận xe → việc tiếp theo là đi xe đưa đón. (C) sai vì anh ta đã từ chối thuê GPS.

groups.transcript:
M1: Thanks for joining me, Hana and Carlos. I just heard from the factory that the packaging for our new headphones won't be ready until the end of the month.
W: That's a problem. We scheduled the launch event for the fifteenth, and we've already sent invitations to the press.
M2: Could we launch with plain boxes and ship the printed packaging later?
M1: I'd rather not. The packaging is a big part of the brand's image. Hana, how difficult would it be to postpone the event by two weeks?
W: The venue is flexible, but I'd need to contact all the journalists again.
M1: OK, let's do that. Carlos, please update the product page on our Web site with the new date.

questions.content: What product are the speakers discussing?
questions.explanation: '…the packaging for our new headphones won't be ready' → sản phẩm là tai nghe.

questions.content: Why does one of the men reject a suggestion?

options.C: The packaging is important to the brand.
options.D: The factory has refused to do it.

questions.explanation: Carlos đề nghị ra mắt với hộp trơn; người quản lý từ chối vì 'The packaging is a big part of the brand's image'.

questions.content: What is Carlos asked to do?
questions.explanation: 'Carlos, please update the product page on our Web site with the new date.' (A) là việc của Hana (liên hệ lại các nhà báo).

groups.transcript:
W: Hello, this is Kitchen Pro customer service. How can I help you?
M: Hi. I bought one of your blenders about six months ago, and now it won't turn on. It's still under warranty, isn't it?
W: Our blenders come with a two-year warranty, so you're covered. Do you have the receipt?
M: I bought it online, so I have the order confirmation e-mail.
W: That'll work. Just forward it to repairs at kitchenpro dot com, and we'll send you a prepaid shipping label. Once we receive the blender, it usually takes about a week to repair.
M: A week? I use it every morning.
W: I understand. In that case, we can send you a replacement right away, and you can return the broken one afterward.

questions.content: Why is the man calling?

options.B: To report a problem with a product
options.C: To ask about a delivery date

questions.explanation: '…now it won't turn on. It's still under warranty, isn't it?' → báo máy xay bị hỏng và hỏi về bảo hành.

questions.content: What does the woman ask the man to do?

options.A: Bring the blender to a store

questions.explanation: 'Just forward it (the order confirmation e-mail) to repairs@…' → chuyển tiếp bằng chứng mua hàng. (B) sai vì công ty gửi nhãn vận chuyển trả trước (prepaid).

questions.content: Why does the man say, "I use it every morning"?

options.B: To explain why the item broke
options.C: To express concern about a waiting period

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: nghe sửa mất một tuần, anh ta nói 'Tôi dùng nó mỗi sáng' → lo ngại thời gian chờ quá lâu; nhân viên liền đề nghị gửi máy thay thế ngay.

groups.transcript:
M: Kelly, have you submitted your travel expenses from the Chicago trip yet?
W: Not yet. I tried this morning, but I couldn't figure out the new expense software. It keeps asking me for a project code.
M: Oh, that's new. Every expense now has to be linked to a client project. You can find the codes on the shared drive, in the Finance folder.
W: Thanks. Is there a deadline?
M: Reports for last month are due on Friday. And remember to scan your receipts. The system doesn't accept photos taken with a phone anymore.
W: Really? I'd better find a scanner, then. I think there's one in the mail room.

questions.content: What are the speakers mainly discussing?

options.D: A problem with a shared drive

questions.explanation: Cả đoạn nói về việc nộp chi phí công tác bằng 'the new expense software' → hệ thống báo cáo chi phí mới.

questions.content: According to the man, what must each expense be linked to?
questions.explanation: 'Every expense now has to be linked to a client project.'

questions.content: Where will the woman most likely go next?
questions.explanation: Cần scan hoá đơn → 'I'd better find a scanner… I think there's one in the mail room.' (A) chỉ là tên thư mục 'Finance folder' – bẫy lặp từ.

groups.transcript:
M: Hi, I'm looking for office space for my design firm. We have twelve employees, and our lease ends in three months.
W: I have a few options. There's a space on Harbor Street that just became available. It's on the top floor, and it gets a lot of natural light.
M: That sounds good. How's the parking situation there? Most of my staff drive to work.
W: The building doesn't have its own parking, but there's a public garage across the street with monthly passes.
M: Hmm, that could get expensive. Is there anything with parking included?
W: There's one in the Westfield Business Park. It's a bit farther from downtown, but it comes with twenty free parking spaces. I can take you to see both of them tomorrow morning.

questions.content: Who most likely is the woman?
questions.explanation: Cô giới thiệu các văn phòng cho thuê và đề nghị dẫn đi xem → nhân viên môi giới bất động sản.

questions.content: What concern does the man mention?

questions.explanation: Trước danh từ 'assistant' cần tính từ sở hữu → 'her'. 'hers' là đại từ sở hữu (đứng một mình), 'herself' là đại từ phản thân.

questions.content: The new branch office in Busan will open ------- the first week of April.
questions.explanation: 'during + khoảng thời gian' = trong suốt/trong khoảng → 'during the first week of April'. 'between' cần hai mốc (between A and B); 'along' chỉ không gian; 'among' = giữa nhiều người/vật.

questions.content: All visitors must wear their identification badges ------- they are in the building.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống nối với mệnh đề 'they are in the building' → cần liên từ; nghĩa 'trong khi/khi đang ở trong toà nhà' → 'while'. 'during' là giới từ (không đi với mệnh đề); 'unless' = trừ khi – sai nghĩa.

questions.content: Guests have consistently praised the Grandview Hotel for its ------- staff.
questions.explanation: Giữa tính từ sở hữu 'its' và danh từ 'staff' cần tính từ → 'helpful' (nhiệt tình, hay giúp đỡ).

questions.content: The marketing team is ------- a survey to learn more about customer preferences.
questions.explanation: Cụm cố định 'conduct a survey' = tiến hành khảo sát. 'attend' đi với sự kiện (meeting, conference); 'arrive' và 'consist (of)' là nội động từ, không có tân ngữ trực tiếp.

questions.content: Our records show that your payment was received ------- March 3.
questions.explanation: Trước ngày cụ thể dùng 'on' (on March 3). 'in' dùng cho tháng/năm, 'at' cho giờ.

questions.content: Mr. Chen has worked in the company's legal department ------- more than fifteen years.
questions.explanation: Thì hiện tại hoàn thành + khoảng thời gian (more than fifteen years) → 'for'. 'since' đi với mốc thời gian (since 2010).

questions.content: Applications that are submitted after the deadline will not be -------.
questions.explanation: Bị động 'will not be + V3': đơn nộp trễ 'sẽ không được xem xét' → 'considered'. 'considerable' là tính từ = đáng kể – sai nghĩa.

questions.content: The factory has seen a significant ------- in production since installing the new equipment.
questions.explanation: Sau mạo từ 'a' và tính từ 'significant' cần danh từ → 'increase' (sự gia tăng). 'an increase in + N' là cụm hay gặp.

questions.content: Please contact the front desk ------- you need extra towels or pillows.
questions.explanation: Nghĩa điều kiện: 'hãy liên hệ lễ tân nếu quý khách cần thêm khăn' → 'if'.

questions.content: The conference room on the third floor is ------- than the one on the first floor.
questions.explanation: Có 'than' → so sánh hơn: 'larger than'.

questions.content: Ms. Park, ------- joined the company last year, has been promoted to regional manager.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ thay cho người (Ms. Park) và làm chủ ngữ của động từ 'joined' → 'who'. 'whom' làm tân ngữ; 'whose' cần danh từ theo sau.

questions.content: The board of directors ------- the merger proposal at its next meeting.
questions.explanation: 'at its next meeting' (cuộc họp tới) → hành động ở tương lai → 'will review'. (B) V-ing không làm động từ chính được.

questions.content: The shipment of printer cartridges was delayed ------- a problem at the port.
questions.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ 'a problem at the port' → cần giới từ chỉ nguyên nhân 'due to'. 'because' cần mệnh đề (hoặc 'because of'); 'despite' = mặc dù – sai nghĩa.

questions.content: Neither the store manager ------- her assistant was available to answer questions about the refund.
questions.explanation: Cặp liên từ 'neither … nor' = không … cũng không.

questions.content: Bexley Foods' profits rose sharply ------- the successful launch of its new snack line.

WESTPORT (January 8) – Beginning March 1, all businesses in Westport will be required to separate recyclable materials from their regular trash. The new rule applies to paper, cardboard, glass, and plastic bottles.
